title: Delay in Your International Wire Transfer
titleZh: 您的國際電匯延遲通知
paragraphs: Subject: Update on your recent transfer

We are writing to inform you that the wire transfer you requested on Monday has been delayed due to a mismatch in the account number provided. The remittance cannot be completed until the correct information is confirmed.

Please reply using the correct account number and the current exchange rate you expect, and we will retry the transaction within one business day. There is no additional fee for correcting this request, but future delays may result in a small charge.
You may also check the status through our online portal or visit any branch and bring your check book for assistance.
Thank you for your patience, Sunrise Bank Customer Service

options: To inform about a delay in a wire transfer
To offer a new banking product
A mismatch in the account number

questions.stem: What can be inferred about future delays caused by incorrect information?
options: They will result in immediate account closure
They will be processed for free every time
They may lead to a small charge
They will not affect the exchange rate
